RERA grants 4-month extension for real estate projects

Indian RERA authorities have been advised by the central government to grant a four-month extension for real estate projects. This advisory cites the West Asia crisis as a force majeure event impacting project timelines. Projects scheduled for completion on or after February 28, 2026, are eligible for this extension. The move is expected to provide relief to the real estate sector and developers.
